answer: Count the witnesses, then count what each is paid. Proof of tax filing via revenue service receipt chain pays in witnesses: receipts the revenue office issued every April for nine years. The violet of the arrangement is the witness's independence - a different office, ledger, boss. A farm must buy a hundred witnesses, and the quill of the purchase is the negotiation: each wants more than the last, and each can walk away with the story. The nectar the gate trusts is the cheapest one: the witness who refuses, because refusal costs the farm the whole account.
